title: Pumas rise: Botafogo close to signing Nathan Silva
seoTitle: Pumas rise: Botafogo close to signing Nathan Silva
subtitle: 29‑year‑old centre‑back, champion with Atlético‑MG, long‑time desire of the Rio club and negotiations are advanced.
excerpt: The word “pumas” tops Brazilian online searches as Botafogo nears the signing of defender Nathan Silva from Pumas‑MEX.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The word "pumas" surged among the most searched terms on the Brazilian internet, driven by a news item shaking the football market: Botafogo is very close to finalising the signing of centre‑back Nathan Silva, 29, currently at Pumas‑MEX. The imminent transfer of the defender to the Rio club generated great interest and spurred online searches.

The negotiation in detail

Botafogo's interest in Nathan Silva is not recent. In the first half of 2026, or in January, the club had already tried to sign the centre‑back. At that time Botafogo offered €1.8 million (R$ 10.9 million then) for 100 % of the player's economic rights, but Pumas rejected the bid, saying the transfer window was closed and there was no time to find a replacement.

Now negotiations have progressed significantly, and the deal is close to being sealed. Botafogo will pay roughly R$ 10 million, according to GLOBO, while the agency RTI Esporte estimates a transaction of about €2.5 million (R$ 15 million at current rates) for the economic rights. Nathan Silva, whose contract with Pumas‑MEX runs until June 2027, is expected to sign a new deal with Botafogo by December 2029, with an anticipated duration of about three and a half years. The information was first published by ESPN and confirmed by GLOBO, and RTI Esporte also reported the recent progress.

Nathan Silva's career

Born in 1997, Nathan Silva, now 29, came through Atlético‑MG. With the Minas Gerais club he won the Brasileirão and the Copa do Brasil in 2021. Besides Atlético‑MG, the defender also played for Coritiba and Atlético‑GO before moving to Mexican football.

In mid‑2023, Nathan Silva was sold to Pumas‑MEX for $4 million (about R$ 20 million at the time). In Mexico the centre‑back quickly became a starter and one of the main options in defence. He kept regular form across seasons and was named the best defender in the Mexican league last season. His experience in Brazilian football helped his adaptation, and his performances featured consistent defensive duels and participation in build‑up play from the back. This market appreciation, driven by his regularity and level, helped bring his name back into Brazilian football discussions.

The role of Nathan Silva at Botafogo

At Botafogo, Nathan Silva arrives to compete for a spot in the defensive line. The Rio squad already includes Ferraresi, Justino, Anthony and Lucas Monzón. Another defender, Kaio Pantaleão, is recovering from a serious knee injury.

Nathan Silva's salary was a key factor in Botafogo's new contract. Currently at Pumas he earns roughly 1.1 million Mexican pesos per month (about R$ 335 thousand), which amounts to about 13.1 million pesos per year, or roughly R$ 4 million annually in approximate conversion. The contract slated until December 2029 underscores Botafogo's intention to keep the defender for the long term.

With information from O GLOBO, Terra.
